problem_statement: Agencies rebuild client reports manually each cycle, creating delays, inconsistency, and low client confidence.
value_proposition: Ship client-ready monthly reporting with one repeatable workflow. Designed for Agency operator teams in Marketing services to validate demand quickly.

offer.headline: Ship client-ready monthly reporting with one repeatable workflow

workflow.prompt_placeholder: e.g. We spend too long rebuilding monthly reports for non-technical clients.

rules.first_step: Define a one-page KPI summary template before adding channel-specific detail.
next_steps: Auto-fill narrative sections from KPI deltas.
Collect client questions to improve the next template iteration.

rules.first_step: Rewrite report output into business outcomes first, then append technical metrics.
next_steps: Map each KPI to an explicit business decision.
Highlight one win and one risk every cycle.

default_response.first_step: Start with one reusable reporting structure and avoid custom format changes per client.
next_steps: Review report quality with a short QA checklist.

metrics.target: At least 5 qualified leads from first 20 targeted users in 14 days
kill_criteria: Fewer than 2 qualified intent captures after 20 targeted visitors
Core workflow completion rate below 20% in first-session usage

adapter.name: client-reporting
adapter.description: For agencies producing recurring client reports and KPI summaries.

business_tests.name: monthly_reporting_response
business_tests.input: Our agency monthly reports are too manual and hard for clients to read.
